pages.title: Bariatric surgeon consultation
lines: FAIRMONT CENTER FOR WEIGHT LOSS SURGERY
Weight hx: gradual gain after retiring. Tried our medical program last year w/ semaglutide; lost a little, could not tolerate the medication, regained.
PMH: T2DM (2016), HTN, GERD w/ LA grade B esophagitis on EGD 2025, hyperlipidemia.
Meds: metformin, glipizide, losartan, pantoprazole, atorvastatin.
Impression: obesity BMI 38.9 w/ T2DM (A1c 7.9), HTN, erosive GERD. RYGB preferred over sleeve given GERD.

pages.title: Medical weight loss program records
lines: FAIRMONT MEDICAL WEIGHT LOSS - PHYSICIAN-SUPERVISED PROGRAM
Medication: semaglutide weekly started 11/03/2025, titrated to 1 mg; stopped 03/2026 for persistent nausea/vomiting.
Diet: 1,600 kcal plan, dietitian counseling each visit. Exercise: walking program.
Result: max loss 9 lb (3.1%) by 02/2026, then regained; 04/13/2026 weight 283 lb (-1.0% from start).
Program outcome: unsuccessful; refer to bariatric surgery.
